# Button

`content/button` &middot; content-level &middot; category: content

## Purpose

Bulletproof call-to-action button. Sits inside any column.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | text |  |
| `href` | url |  |

## Optional fields

None.

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Solid brand-colored button.
- **outline**: Transparent with a brand-colored border, for secondary actions. Sets `background: transparent`, `color: @colors.primary`, `borderWidth: 2px`, `borderColor: @colors.primary`, `darkMode: outline`.
- **subtle**: Surface-colored with a hairline border, for low-emphasis actions. Sets `background: @colors.surface`, `color: @colors.primary`, `borderWidth: 1px`, `borderColor: @colors.border`, `darkMode: outline`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `align` | alignment | `"center"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.primary"` |
| `color` | color | `"@colors.primaryText"` |
| `radius` | length | `"@theme.button.radius"` |
| `borderWidth` | length | `"@theme.button.borderWidth"` |
| `borderColor` | color | `"@colors.primary"` |
| `size` | one of `small`, `medium`, `large` | `"medium"` |
| `innerPadding` | spacing | `"@theme.button.innerPadding"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"16px 24px"` |
| `darkMode` | one of `solid`, `outline`, `none` | `"solid"` |

## Responsive behavior

No dedicated responsive settings. It follows the width of the column or section it sits in.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Rounded corners render square in Outlook desktop. | Fine. | Swaps via dm-button classes where honored, otherwise keeps its own light colors. |



## Example usage

This is a content-level component: it goes inside a column, so put it in the `content` of a `layout/section` (or another layout).

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('content/button', {
  "label": "Shop the collection",
  "href": "https://example.com/collections/summer"
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "content/button",
  "data": {
    "label": "Shop the collection",
    "href": "https://example.com/collections/summer"
  }
}
```
